newsitem.title: USA: Owens Corning ad plan to cost up to $5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Owens Corning ad plan to cost up to $5 mln.

text.p: Owens Corning Chief Executive Officer Glen Hiner said on Wednesday the company will spend between $3 million and $5 million on its new advertising campaign to promote its System Thinking business strategy.
Owens Corning said the System Thinking program is the company's new approach to product development, customer service, business operations and growth strategies.
The program aims to change the way homeowners think about home maintenance and improvement, the company said.
Hiner made his comments at a press conference in New York.
